properties.title: Beverly Hills Modern Glass Estate
properties.description: A sleek glass-and-stone estate in the Beverly Hills flats. Walls of glass open to a resort backyard with an infinity pool, while a chef's kitchen and primary retreat define effortless California luxury.
properties.map_address: 612 N Crescent Drive, Beverly Hills, CA 90210

properties.title: Malibu Oceanfront Contemporary
properties.description: Sited directly on the sand, this contemporary frames whitewater views from nearly every room. Floor-to-ceiling glass, a sea-facing primary suite, and a private deck just steps from the tide.

properties.title: Santa Monica Beachside Condo
properties.description: Bright sixth-floor residence two blocks from the beach with ocean-peek views, a full-service building, and a walkable lifestyle near the pier, dining, and Third Street Promenade.

properties.title: Westwood Village Modern Condo
properties.description: Turnkey high-rise condo on the Wilshire Corridor, minutes from UCLA and Westwood Village. Open plan, floor-to-ceiling windows, and full-service amenities in a prime Westside location.

properties.title: Bel Air Hillside Contemporary
properties.description: Gated Bel Air contemporary perched for canyon-to-city views. Open volumes, a glass-walled great room, and an infinity-edge pool that floats above the lights of Los Angeles.

properties.title: Pacific Palisades Family Home
properties.description: Traditional-meets-modern home in the coveted Palisades, walkable to the village and top schools. Light-filled rooms, a flat grassy yard, and a chef's kitchen built for gatherings.

properties.title: Calabasas Gated Estate
properties.description: Behind the gates of a sought-after Calabasas community, this estate pairs generous living spaces with a private backyard, pool, and built-in BBQ — resort living minutes from The Commons.
properties.map_address: 25140 Prado De Las Peras, Calabasas, CA 91302

properties.title: Encino Mid-Century Ranch
properties.description: Beautifully updated single-story ranch south of the boulevard in Encino. Open living, a remodeled kitchen, and a large entertainer's yard with a sparkling pool on a quiet tree-lined street.
